Download a pinned model

Source: R/cache.R
model_download.Rd

model_download() downloads the files of one pinned model into the cache. A pinned model is a fixed set of files (an ONNX graph and a tokenizer, or an embedding table for the static model) at an immutable Hugging Face revision; installing it locally once makes encoding work offline and keeps the model identical across machines and over time.

Only files that are missing or fail verification are fetched, and each is checked against its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before it is kept. The function runs only when called; the package never downloads during installation, loading, examples or tests. It returns the model's directory in the cache, invisibly.

Verbs given a model name that is not installed offer this download themselves (see encode()). ONNX Runtime, needed by transformer models, is installed separately with install_runtime(). For models outside the pinned list, see load_custom().

Usage

model_download(
  model = "all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
  cache_dir = default_cache_dir(),
  quiet = FALSE,
  timeout = 600
)

Arguments

model

Name of a pinned model, as listed by models() (default "all-MiniLM-L6-v2").

cache_dir

Cache root (default cache_dir()).

quiet

Suppress the start message and download progress (default FALSE).

timeout

Minimum download timeout in seconds (default 600); a larger getOption("timeout") is kept.

Value

The model's directory in the cache, invisibly.

Conditions

sbert_unknown_model when model names no pinned model; sbert_download_failed when a file cannot be downloaded or moved into the cache; sbert_cache_invalid when a downloaded file fails size or hash verification.

See also

models() for the pinned models; model_status() to check an installation; load_model() to load it; model_remove() to delete it; install_runtime() for ONNX Runtime.

Examples

# Report what is already cached; nothing is downloaded here.
model_status(tempdir())
#>             file
#> 1     model.onnx
#> 2 tokenizer.json
#>                                                                                       path
#> 1     /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41/model.onnx
#> 2 /tmp/RtmpjrAgkS/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41/tokenizer.json
#>   exists valid expected_bytes actual_bytes
#> 1  FALSE FALSE       90405214           NA
#> 2  FALSE FALSE         466247           NA

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  model_download()
}
# }
